messages:
emma: Hey team — on a customer call now. They say the /v1/rerank endpoint started returning a bunch of 504s/502s over the weekend under sustained load. p95 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s and then we started seeing gateway timeouts. They saw retries piling up and final responses with HTTP 502.

emma: Repro steps they gave: send batches of 8 queries every 50ms (concurrency ~40), each query with ~5 candidates (avg tokens ~120). They saw errors after ~3k requests.

emma: Example failing curl we got from their support packet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"query":"best mango smoothie","candidates":[{"id":"a","text":"..."},{"id":"b","text":"..."}],"top_k":5}' \
  --max-time 10
```
Returned: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out and body: `\{"error\":\"upstream timed out\"}`

emma: Customer says they also saw some weird scores (ties / all zeros) when the errors first started — may be partial processing or fallback behavior. Raising since multiple customers pinged support.

chris: Thanks. I'm checking prod-us-west2 rerank pool dashboards now. I can see the p95 and error rate spike at 2026-03-14T03:14 UTC. Dashboard: https://app.redwood/internal/dashboards/rerank-prod-us-west2 (private link).

chris: Quick hypotheses: upstream model inference hit a slow path (long input sequences / kv cache stress) -> requests queued -> envoy/nginx idle timeout fired -> 504s. Also possible connection pool exhaustion on our inference frontend (too many concurrent keepalive sockets).

ada: Two things to validate from the payloads: 1) Are clients sending huge candidate arrays (we have an internal soft limit of 256 tokens per candidate), 2) Are they using top_k > candidates length? Formatting bugs sometimes cause the reranker to do extra work.

chris: On the infra side I'm grabbing logs from the envoys and the inference workers. Early sign: a bunch of 499/504 from envoy with downstream timings showing "response.completed" > 1.2s and upstream calls showing timeouts at the model process: `ModelWorker.execute() latency 1200-1800ms` spikes.

chris: Also seeing a sharp rise in keepalive conn in use in the frontend pool: pool_usage ~ 95% at spike. When pool exhausted new connections stall and hit LB timeouts.

emma: Customer attached a snippet of JSON they used. It had trailing commas in the candidates array (invalid JSON tolerated by some clients?) — possible partial parse fallback. I'll paste sanitized snippet below:
```json
{
  "query": "compare bluetooth speakers",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "JBL charge 5..."},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "Bose soundlink..."},
  ],
  "top_k": 3
}
```
Note the trailing comma after candidate 2.

ada: That could explain unexpected scores if the server tolerant-parsed it differently or we ended up with an empty candidate in the list. We should add stricter validation returning 400 if candidates malformed.

chris: Immediate mitigation suggestions:
- throttle client concurrency via rate-limit (support can suggest)
- temporarily increase frontend idle timeout to 10s to avoid envoy 504s while we stabilize (ops)
- increase pool size for keepalive connections on the frontend to reduce connection stalls
- deploy a short-term config to route rerank requests to a scaled up dedicated pool (if the customer is on dedicated) or to the lower-capacity but more stable rerank-lite model as fallback

emma: For support messaging: ask customers to 1) verify JSON (no trailing commas), 2) reduce batch size to 4, 3) disable aggressive client-side retries (they amplify the storm).

chris: Repro instructions for infra/qa: we can run load with this toy wrk script:
```bash
wrk -t8 -c40 -d120s -s ./rerank_load.lua http://frontend.internal/v1/rerank
# rerank_load.lua should post payloads with candidates ~5, token length ~100-150, and loop random inputs
```
I can reproduce p95 >= 1.2s and subsequent 504s using concurrency 40+ with batch_size 8 on the current autoscaler settings.

ada: Quick fix action items I recommend:
- add strict JSON schema check in the rerank handler -> return 400 on malformed candidates
- add server-side candidate count and token_count header validation (400/422) before enqueuing work
- emit metric `rerank.request.queue_depth` so we can alert before envoy timeouts

oncall-bot: @emma flagged incident on-call. Pager sent to @chris. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1374.

chris: I'm scaling up the frontend pool and bumping keepalive pool sizes now. Will monitor for next 15m and post graphs.

emma: I've messaged the affected customers with temporary mitigations and asked them to stop retries and reduce concurrency.

chris: Update: after increasing pool + scaling workers, error rate dropped to baseline within ~8 minutes and p95 returned to ~150-200ms. No more 502s after worker scale. Still want code fixes to prevent recurrence.

ada: Filing a GitHub issue for validation + telemetry: GH-rrk-211: "Rerank: strict payload validation + queue_depth metric". Adding tests for trailing commas and empty candidate entries.

emma: Support follow-up plan: 1) ask customers to re-run with validated payload and sample curl we provide, 2) offer to run small-scale smoke test from our side, 3) escalate to account team if they require SLA credits.

chris: Long-term infra fixes: tune autoscaler to scale earlier on median latency, add request queue length-based scaling, and implement connection pool backpressure (reject fast when pool saturated instead of waiting).

ada: Also propose adding guardrail server-side: if model inference > 800ms for N samples, automatically switch rerank traffic to rerank-lite for short window and start warmup. We'll file design doc.

emma: OK — assigning owners: chris -> infra fixes + incident follow-up, ada -> schema validation + tests, support (emma) -> customer comms + repro kit.

emma: I'll attach the sanitized logs and the customers' original payloads to INC-2026-1374. If anyone finds more customers affected, ping here and I'll update the ticket. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed config change: frontend keepalive pool size increased on prod-us-west2 (config-2026-03-14-16). Rollout 100% completed.

chris: Monitoring shows stable now. Closing monitoring window but keeping ticket open until schema validation shipped.

emma: Thanks everyone. Closing thread unless new evidence shows more errors.
